title: GUILDVEIL Brand Guidelines
summary: A distinctive brand identity designed for GUILDVEIL, a dark fantasy tattoo studio inspired by forgotten folklore, aged libraries, and quiet mystery. The visual system blends gothic elegance with modern craftsmanship, creating an immersive brand experience that reflects fine line, blackwork, and illustrative tattoo artistry.
